definition: In artificial intelligence, apprenticeship learning (or learning from demonstration or imitation learning) is the process of learning by observing an expert.
details: It can be viewed as a form of supervised learning, where the training dataset consists of task executions by a demonstration teacher.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. Here is the short version: In artificial intelligence, apprenticeship learning (or learning from demonstration or imitation learning) is the process of learning by observing an expert.
